items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: some cat named Sumner Smith played alto. Anyway, we were booked in there at same time

ctx.x: Scatman Carruthers, and he had his band out there. He had Benny Bailey, and some cat named Sumner Smith played alto. Anyway, we were booked in there at same time, so it was a nice gig, you know.
